notes: Your phone's Lantern now has its own console: a small neural network that learns which of its minds to listen to (associations, feeling, expectation), starting from its own playful, warm temperament and learning from your ratings, your reactions and whether you pick up what it brings up. !console shows it; !console off and !console restore N keep you in control. Its minds now also choose what it wants to talk about in Lantern talks.
